headline: Asian Chip Markets Rebound
what: South Korea's KOSPI rose about 2.1%, and Japan's Nikkei 225 gained about 1.4% after Thursday's technology selloff.
context: Both markets include major chip exporters.
why_it_matters: A steadier Asian session can reduce stress around U.S. semiconductor shares.

headline: Indonesia Stocks Suffer Historic Drop
what: Indonesia's main index lost more than 10%, its deepest one-day decline since 1998, after an MSCI downgrade warning.
context: Funds that copy MSCI indexes may need to sell excluded shares.
why_it_matters: Index rules and foreign money can quickly change a country's financing conditions.

headline: Global Leaders Weigh AI and Inflation
what: Finance leaders in Bangkok are discussing high inflation, energy risk, and possible gains from artificial intelligence.
context: The IMF and World Bank meetings bring together central banks and finance ministries.
why_it_matters: Their choices can shape rates, currencies, debt costs, and global growth.
